name: Mithril
introduce:
AST-07 Mithril
An-Holt Corporation's new medium tactical model surpasses its predecessor, Hermes, with enhanced performance, armor, and equipment.
Equipped with the latest Arashium drive core and optimized for next-gen tactical weapons, it offers premium battlefield adaptability, and the onboard Supercomputer Type-R provides advanced enemy analysis. Rumor has it that the Mithril once housed a [Dive] connection device, indicating it was once a specialized ST project for a unique pilot.

30088.SpecificEffects:

20364.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, gains DMG <color=#F74848>+6%</color> for each debuff inflicted. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times. Lasts for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
